description: This file is a PHP source file for a SuiteCRM module, specifically generating a pipeline pipeline-by-sales-stage chart with associated HTML forms, data retrieval, and XML chart data creation.

methods.name: gen_xml_pipeline_by_sales_stage
methods.description: Generates the XML data for a pipeline chart based on sales stages, date range, user IDs, and chart size, then creates and returns the chart image.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL query string to retrieve opportunity data filtered by user preferences and request parameters.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns an array of fields to group SQL query results by, specifically blocking grouping by sales_stage.
